**The multi-agent panel for the dsh web GUI - watch every agent, approve in one place.**

A plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`).

## Why

Running three agents in three tabs is not orchestration - it's juggling. The panel makes parallel agents observable and steerable from one surface.

## What it does

- One panel: every live agent with status, budget burn, and current action
- Approval requests from any agent queue in one place
- Inter-agent messages visible as threads
- Spawn and stop from the panel, one click, fully logged

## How it fits dsh

A web GUI slot fed by swarm / orchestrator events; works with plain dsh subagents too.

## Design principles

1. Observe-first design - no agent is a black box
2. Approval is the only modal
3. Color encodes budget health, never decoration

## Status

Name reserved, spec locked. Roadmap: 0.1 live roster + approval queue -> 0.2 message threads -> 0.3 steering controls. The first release lands
when the 0.1 scope above is fully implemented and tested - not before.
